required_checks.requirement: Pack status must clearly state Draft - NoSend - NoWrite - Simulation Only.
Pack must not include email sending, invitations, or outreach instructions.
Pack must not execute write calls, orders, ledger mutations, credit consumption, or account creation.
Pack must not activate payment, invoice, checkout, or subscription.
Pack must use synthetic examples only and avoid personal data or real lead lists.
Machine must understand when to use Target Discovery, Score Pack, Domain Enrichment, Deep Analysis, Action Pack, Opportunity Feed, API Starter, and API Pro.
Machine must understand no-list, existing-list, missing-domain, high-score, and confirmed-evidence routing.
Reference links must be public documentation links only and must not expose private authenticated panels.
Pack must not contain API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, cookies, FTP credentials, GitHub tokens, Cloudflare tokens, Postman tokens, or DataForSEO credentials.
Owner approval must be required before any external send, marketplace publication, live billing, production key distribution, or real customer-data processing.
